source_geometry.flag_boundary: L=4U lies in the proper flag locus of the same16D closure

conclusion: The specified characteristic-zero ambient local ring has t^2=0; the whole sufficiently general-beta fiber of the dominant16D pure-cubic binary endpoint is removed.
limitations: Uses the good-reduction and DVR torsion-free argument in the proof note, not a finite-field sample inference.
The flag endpoints of other pure-cubic tails and the remaining binary/flag strata remain separate.
No full affine-fiber finiteness or five-point exhaustion.
